files.prompt: Generate ONE SINGLE isolated Roblox pet inventory icon as a standalone square PNG with genuine transparent alpha background. This is a separate asset for exactly ONE pet, not a collage, not a grid, not a sprite sheet, never include other pets. Match the cute cubic pet identity and thick black outlines in the supplied references, but redraw this one subject cleanly. Crisp smooth clean edges, flat saturated colors with clean broad low-poly shading, professional game UI illustration. NO grain, NO speckles, NO noise, NO texture, NO fog, NO rays, NO bloom, NO glow, NO background, NO floor, NO shadow outside the character silhouette, NO labels, NO text, NO UI borders, NO checkerboard drawn into image. Standardized composition for this icon series: square canvas, the main CUBE BODY is 52 percent of the canvas width, its center at 50 percent x and 60 percent y; bottom of feet at 85 percent canvas height. Preserve this exact body scale instead of enlarging small pets to fill the frame. Decorations/wings may extend around the body but stay within 8 percent canvas safe margin. Mild three-quarter view facing viewer, showing front plus a small right side, same camera and bright top-left lighting as other icons. Large friendly black eyes with white outlines and white highlight, small cute mouth. Keep entire pet silhouette and accessories intact. Subject: a red cube cat with red pointed ears and two red mushroom caps with white spots on cream stems on its head. Reference sheets are identity guides only; output this ONE pet only.
